buildCommand: cd apps/portal && npx storybook build -o public/storybook && next build

redirects.// note: /install.md, not /install. Redirects run ahead of the app, so sourcing /install sent every visitor to raw markdown and made the human install page — the one the site header links to — unreachable in production. AGENTS.md splits them: /install for people, /install.md for agents.
